place.eventDescription: Charged when a listing is an accepted match under the issue #127 rules. Rejected, blocked, empty, and error rows are saved and not billed.

email-found.eventDescription: Charged only when website enrichment returns a validated email for an accepted place. A miss, a robots skip, or a failed fetch is not billed.

score.eventDescription: Charged only when an accepted place receives a lead score. Scoring that does not produce a number is not billed.
